one_liner: Free Camera app provides togglable freecam and orbit camera modes with a UI panel and configurable hotkeys for easy navigation and cinematic shots.
primary_use_case: Allows developers and users to explore worlds with a free‑move camera or orbit around a target, useful for debugging, cinematic captures, or enhanced navigation.
